title: Curate quantitative proteasome digestion time courses (MSV000092631) for availability modeling
body:
Parent #723. Complements #759 (cellular MAPP perturbations), #757 (independent precursor context), and #762 (MS response calibration). This requests a shared Hitlist source and recipe, not a Presto-only workbook adapter.

## Concrete source and modeling need

The current cellular MAPP composition comparison has not beaten uniform on held-out data. A controlled substrate-to-products time course would let us test whether a model can learn peptide production and subsequent removal before introducing APC capture and MHC selection.

[Soh et al., Nature Communications 2024](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-024-45339-3) report quantitative digestion of 15 full proteins by purified human 20S standard proteasomes. [MassIVE MSV000092631 / PXD044463](https://massive.ucsd.edu/ProteoSAFe/dataset.jsp?accession=MSV000092631) is public and lists:
- `other/aSPIRE_outputs_zip.zip`: 963,763,954 bytes.
- `metadata/Identifier.xlsx`: 28,339 bytes.
- `methods/PSP_proteins_PRIDE_v2_JL.docx`: 20,209 bytes.
- 15 non-resource-fork substrate FASTAs under `sequence/AA_Sequences/`.

The public file inventory has 505 entries. The original processed archive and metadata have now been recovered and inspected, with independent H4 arithmetic replay and a concrete RF1 time conflict documented below. Shared source admission and all-substrate quantitative replay remain open. Its recorded license is CC0. Prefer extracting the original processed tables and metadata before downloading raw spectra or the 7.8 GB spliced-search database.

The paper describes unnormalized MS1 peak-area measurements followed by background filtering/subtraction and averaging technical replicates within biological replicates. Most substrates have 0, 1, 2, 4 and 24 h measurements; alpha-synuclein has a different schedule. Products without a positive 4 h value (3 h for alpha-synuclein) were removed from the final quantified panel. These are selected relative MS responses, not molar peptide concentrations.

## Shared curation requirements

1. Preserve original bytes, hashes, source/member/row coordinates, file-to-run-to-digest relationships, biological preparation versus technical acquisition, substrate sequence/construct/reference, enzyme preparation/isotype/species, substrate species, input concentrations and enzyme:substrate ratio, buffer, temperature, time and termination procedure. Purified enzyme origin (e.g. a cell line) is not an APC specimen or a gene-knockout condition. Unknown links stay unknown.
2. Preserve all original quantity layers where available: precursor charge/modification/isotope contributions, measured peak area, background, corrected signal, technical-replicate aggregation and final selected values. Represent zero/unreported/below-background/removed/not-assayed separately. Recover excluded rows from upstream outputs when possible; never turn the final selected panel into a complete negative set.
3. Replay the publication's background rule using original contributors: per-peptide maximum at time zero, global median cutoff, threshold/removal and subtraction, technical averaging, then terminal-time selection. Confirm the implementation from the deposited outputs; retain conflicts instead of silently forcing agreement.
4. Keep contiguous hydrolysis products separate from cis/trans-spliced products, synthesis errors and contaminants, while retaining their measurements and ambiguous mappings. Preserve all possible sequence/position assignments and original I/L handling. A simple span model may exclude spliced/ambiguous rows under a named policy, but must not relabel them as negatives or duplicate quantities across mappings.
5. Expose a registered time-course recipe through the common evidence query/recipe interface. Keep fragments shorter than typical MHC ligands and nonbinders; no affinity filter. Declare the source's 5–40 residue quantification/search scope and all additional selection. A normalized composition target and total captured/detected signal are distinct endpoints; neither establishes total molar production.
6. Freeze source/recipe manifests, all admission and exclusion reasons, original versus derived values, and suitable substrate/preparation/run split constraints. Assess time-course repeatability before a new exact-enumeration versus REINFORCE experiment. Keep related fragments, modified forms and repeated acquisitions grouped, and report the small number of independent parent substrates.

## Acceptance

- Source inventory and documented access/coverage, including missing raw versus processed layers.
- Independent replay of quantitative derivations and all retained source joins.
- Homogeneous context/quantity/selection fields and original-source round trips; no separate experiment-only curation schema.
- A declared endpoint that supports a bounded local kinetic test, with prospective validation/test groups and missingness policy.
- Explicit limits: purified standard-proteasome digestion does not measure APC trafficking, TAP, cellular clearance, MHC binding, or intracellular concentrations. MS response and source selection still limit interpretation.

InvitroSPI / ProteasomeDB (doi:10.1038/s41597-022-01890-6, Figshare 17143865.v1) is a related candidate for identification support, but its documented 26-column table supplies PSM scores/identities rather than a quantitative abundance column. Do not use PSM counts as concentration targets by default.

No author outreach is requested.


## Original-source recovery and conflicts verified (2026-10-23)

[Full registered audit and independent H4 arithmetic replay](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/0b92401/experiments/2026-10-23_0800_codex_digestion-source-audit/README.md). All 18 original assets are now recovered: the complete 963,763,954-byte processed archive, identifier workbook, deposited methods and 15 literal substrate FASTAs. Explicit anonymous FTP with verified TLS works; plain FTP requires TLS, website download returned429 and HTTPS on the FTP host timed out. All 17 nested condition ZIPs / 391 entries pass original CRC checks. All final-table substrate sequences match their deposited FASTAs exactly.

The source exposes 388 main-search acquisitions, 5,792,969 Skyline rows and 545,664 raw peptide/run quantities. Final tables contain 53,144 quantified peptide/biological-replicate rows plus269 annotation-only rows, 213,022 positive values, 62,860 zero values and 4,782 literal NaNs. The three Ffh enzyme:substrate ratios must remain grouped with their common construct. All raw source names join the original workbook; original biological-replicate aliases are recoverable through those joins.

**Specific blocking conflict:** `HRoetschke_221222_180123_HFGoe_RF1_b1R1_0h` and `..._b1R2_0h` are time0 in the workbook and filenames but time1 in QUANTITIES_raw.RData, affecting 2,278 rows. All other raw time joins match. Preserve both original observations and explicit conflict provenance; do not silently use the final RF1 aggregation or repair only its label. RF1 is pending reconciliation before kinetic fitting.

The tagged postprocessor maps technical3/4 to1/2, derives baseline from zero-time controls, forces corrected time-zero values to zero and censors later nonpositive residuals as missing. There are9,716 final rows with repeated time labels. Keep the original source/control/acquisition identity rather than treating those slots as independent temporal measurements. Six contaminant-database metadata rows also disagree between enzyme labels and `_Try_`/`_Chymo_` filenames/search names; preserve conflicts rather than guessing a correction.

Independent Python arithmetic from original H4 Skyline/RData layers reconstructs all27,432 raw quantities and13,284 final vector entries (444missing), with maximum relative error5.04e-15. This verifies background handling and technical aggregation for H4 only. It does not independently verify synthesis-error mapping/removal or all other substrates. Reference aSPIRE1.0 source is pinned to c3d6c9112b2fd88d7e9453b1f23dc338f52c172b, without asserting that exact commit generated the deposition. The deposited final table is not automatically the additional paper-selected positive4h/3h panel.

Next acceptance work is the shared typed source/recipe: retain all raw, filtered and corrected layers and contributors; separate forced-zero/censored/annotation-only states; preserve per-substrate species, enzyme preparation, substrate amounts/ratios, controls and replicate identities; replay derivations across admitted substrates and assess replicate temporal signal before freezing grouped evaluation. No training has used this source. No new author outreach or separate Presto curator. Full APC availability/concentration qualification remains open.

## Shared-source candidate and kinetic qualification (2026-10-23)

Shared source support is implemented in draft PR #773 (977adc2), based on merged #772. [Registered real-source report](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/1503d67/experiments/2026-10-23_1018_codex_shared-digestion-source/README.md).

The actual 250-file package preserves all 218 prior source payloads byte-for-byte. All 11 new canonical relations and all 33 old baselines pass. Independent original-byte replay checks every selected workbook/FASTA/CSV record, independently decodes all 34 RData frames, validates typed numeric values/run joins/final slots and reproduces every canonical query hash. Original RF1 conflicts, forced zeros, missing values, modifications/splice claims and scoped enzyme/substrate/protocol metadata remain explicit. Format/lint, strict docs, 37 focused tests and the guarded normal suite (3,341 tests) pass. Final-head hosted CI/review/deployment remain pending.

There is still no registered training recipe. This replay validates source typing, not all underlying quantitative arithmetic or scientific correctness. Next: independently replay raw/background/technical aggregation across admitted substrates, exclude or reconcile RF1, define contiguous-product/mapping eligibility, evaluate repeated temporal signal and freeze source-group splits plus an MS-response/selection likelihood. No biological training has used the new source.

The separate [exact-versus-sampled kinetic experiment](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/1503d67/experiments/2026-10-23_1021_codex_independent-cut-qualification/README.md) qualifies a minimal independent-cut process on synthetic data. It conserves residue mass and retains every product. Exact amounts match all cut-state sums to 1.11e-16; two-group score-gradient expectations agree to 1.82e-17. Both sampled group sizes recover known rates (median relative errors 3.43%/1.66% for 32/128); exact recovery is numerical precision. Independent NumPy replay checks all 10,000 updates, 30 noninitial checkpoints and 2,940 predictions. This fits rates directly with known response, not sequence-to-rate transfer or real APC concentrations. The full availability objective remains open.

## Bounded temporal admission and signal now verified (2026-10-23)

Source PR773 is merged; recipe/release work is tracked by775. Presto has published [all17-condition arithmetic](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/1d585b9/experiments/2026-10-23_1057_codex_digestion-arithmetic/README.md), [full canonical admission/replay](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/1d585b9/experiments/2026-10-23_1123_codex_digestion-timecourse-admission/README.md) and [training-only temporal repeatability](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/1d585b9/experiments/2026-10-23_1138_codex_digestion-temporal-signal/README.md). The earlier body sections are historical snapshots. All545,664 raw quantities/280,664 final slots replay, but four conditions use mock baseline rows. Admission retains30,566curves/125,423positive measurements with6/3/2 admitted train/val/test parents and original exclusions. Other-label temporal prediction beats no change in5/6 training parents (equal-parent log10 RMSE0.673 vs0.986); LEDGF remains a negative result. Independent replay verifies every source/target/group decision and all67,576 diagnostic predictions. Reviewed source/zero-count changes preserve admitted targets byte-for-byte. No biological kinetic fit, calibrated MS-response or APC concentration model is established. Upstream held-out descriptive repeatability exposure is documented; no model test outcomes or resplit have been used.775 retains final-head software/release acceptance; full availability goal remains open.
